decisions.reason: The web tool has very low marginal cost to keep and its market uncertainty is not resolved, so the option remains open.
The related automation product was dropped, signaling weaker prospects, but this system's own value is still uncertain and keeping costs are low, so it is retained for now.
Being close to the firm's established offer lowers uncertainty, and the cost of keeping the option open is manageable, so it is kept.
